I've already read the document, so now I'm turning it into structured output. It's a Korean delivery note from Hwaseong Memory Co. for game cards: line CMP-GAM-001, 68,000 pieces across 13 boxes, shipped under PO 4500318707, with a total weight of 117 kg.

I'm noting the remarks as 취급주의, meaning handle with care, and the receiver's handwritten signature plus the RECEIVED stamp dated 27.10.2026. The red company stamp overlaps the unit and box columns, partly covering the "단위" header and the "13," and I'm reading the quantity as 68000 since the space is just a thousands separator. The weight is 117 kg, packages are 13 (shown twice), and there are no corrections.
